tldr: For the identifiable intervention law \(\nu_1(P)\), the exact periodic \(C^2\) five-to-three decoder class with derivative-sum bound ten and unrestricted rank has the proved minimax bracket \(c n^{-2/5}\le R_n\le C n^{-6/17}\). The total finite original-record baseline attains the upper endpoint. The empirical treated-arm law has exact-order worst-case risk \(n^{-1/3}\), yielding a baseline-to-empirical ratio at most \(C n^{-1/51}\) and a minimax-to-empirical ratio at least \(c n^{-1/15}\). This is a strict polynomial improvement from the declared smoothness. The sharp scale \(r_n\), a matched estimator \(\widehat\nu^\star\), and matched testing families \(H_n\) are solely unresolved outputs of the sharp-risk question. Solving it would provide the exact precision scale, its necessary logarithmic factors, and stress-test geometry. The consumer setting is prospective distributional reporting, with no dataset-membership claim.
